goal: Design owner-accessible off-machine backup and encrypted key escrow on Google Drive for Singapore, without creating credentials, exporting managed data or changing release gates.
successCriteria: Explain Supabase plugin authorization vs independently generated backup encryption identity.
Define portable public-key backup encryption, passphrase-encrypted private identity on restricted Drive, and independent owner-held unlock secret.
Provide simple lost-machine/lost-Drive/password rotation recovery flows with Auth/Storage/config coverage and measurable acceptance.
Verify current Drive/age official docs and read-only connected Drive folder metadata; no uploads, real key generation or database writes.
untouchedSurfaces: Website/Edge/SQL/mobile/Admin and existing backup/key vault unchanged.
Release profile/legacy ledger/target allowlist and production credentials unchanged.

impact.entryPoint: Private Vietnamese owner design packet, future backup and restore operator controls; no product UI change.
impact.dataWrite: Local design/config and sanitized metadata receipts only. Future design separates ciphertext, encrypted private identity and owner-held unlock secret.
impact.backendContract: No Supabase API or SQL changes; full canonical28 target and waitlist consent/suppression must survive eventual restore.
impact.adminVisibility: Owner receives status, timestamp, checksum and restore report. No private identity, DB dump, password or PII in Admin/log/chat.
impact.privacySafety: Least privilege Drive ACL, public encryption recipient for backup job, owner-only decryption and an independent recovery password/copy. Existing DPAPI remains local QA only.
impact.observability: Future source/target/key-version/digest/upload-readback receipts; missing backup or restore marks BLOCKED, not healthy by metadata.
impact.rollback: Design only. Future backups append immutable versions, preserve old keys until retention and restore accepted, never overwrite the live database.

canonicalContracts: Current canonical28 schema and release gate remain unchanged.
Portable age encrypted-identity and public-recipient format from official docs; no custom cryptographic format proposed.
